note: Nassau County NY does not zone; its towns and cities do. Oyster Bay, North Hempstead, Hempstead (Town) and Glen Cove publish zoning only as PDF maps (Hempstead's ArcGIS layer is an index of PDF sheets with no district attributes). The county GIS server (gis.nassaucountyny.gov) has no zoning district layer; its NCPC viewer holds referral cases only. Long Beach NY has no found service; the 'LB Zoning Map' hub item is Long Beach, California.
